import copy,json,py_compile
from work import evaluate
py_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True)
request={'claim':'boundary','conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None}}
evidence=[{'source':'verified-old','claim':'boundary','value':False,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},{'source':'unverified-new','claim':'boundary','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':False,'supersedes':['verified-old']},{'source':'wrong-type','claim':'boundary','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':0},'verified':True}]
policy={'required_conditions':['mode','calibration'],'require_verified':True}
before=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
expected={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['verified-old'],'unknowns':[]}
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
assert (request,evidence,policy)==before
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: current_evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,current_evidence,current_policy) for r in requests]
print(json.dumps({'boundary':actual,'report':report},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
